title: On the involution preserving properties of semi-discrete Active Flux methods on simplex
summary: We study the involution-preserving properties of the Active Flux method on unstructured triangular meshes. Two model problems are considered: the two-dimensional linear acoustic system, which satisfies a curl involution on the velocity field, and the two-dimensional Maxwell equations with an in-plane magnetic field, which satisfy a divergence involution. Both systems can be written in conservative form. The question we address is how a single discretization can satisfy the conservative form and the involution at the same time.
